How the numbers work

WPM counts correct characters still in the passage, including spaces, in groups of five per active minute. Accuracy counts correct character attempts divided by all character attempts, including mistakes you later corrected. Backspace is an editing action.

Pair and zone timings are medians of consecutive correct letters within words. Errors, edits, spaces and focus changes break a pair. A pause while the test stays focused can include time spent reading or thinking. The keyboard map assumes US QWERTY.

Practice suggestions need three observations across two different words. The side comparison needs eight samples on each side. These minimums screen out sparse data. The passage, word familiarity and device can still affect the result. A faster retest is one observation.
